T:P1.1.text: Innovative Industrial Packaging That Moves the World | Greif

T:P1.2.text: Greif is an industrial packaging products and services leader with a vision to be the best performing customer service company in the world.

T:P1.3.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services, striving to be the advantage that helps our customers win.

T:P1.4.text: Greif is committed to partnering with you to provide a comprehensive and innovative product portfolio to protect and safely transport customers' products worldwide.

T:P1.5.text: Greif is unwavering in its commitment to the wise use of financial, natural, and human resources to afford future generations the ability to meet their needs.

T:P1.6.text: At Greif, your work has purpose, colleagues care about your well-being and you have the opportunity to grow and thrive. Service and leadership are the core of everything we do.

T:P1.7.text: Creating packaging solutions for life's essentials.

T:P1.8.text: Greif is a global leader in industrial packaging products and services — pursuing its vision to be the best customer service company in the world.

T:P1.9.text: Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty products.

T:P1.10.text: We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States. Greif is strategically positioned in multiple countries to serve customers of all sizes and needs.

T:P1.11.text: These targets set specific and measurable goals that build on the company’s announcement to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions 28% by the end of the decade.

T:P1.12.text: Reach Zero Waste to Landfill at 97% of its Production Facilities

T:P1.13.text: By reducing, recycling, composting, reusing, and incinerating with energy recovery, Greif targets 97% of its production facilities achieving zero-waste to landfills.

T:P1.15.text: Working across a vast portfolio of raw materials and products, Greif recyclability targets will be benchmarked by weight, and consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.16.text: Achieve an Average of 60% Recycled Raw Material Content Across Products

T:P1.17.text: Recycled content targets for Greif products are minimum averages benchmarked across a portfolio of materials and products by weight, consolidated at a company level.

T:P1.19.text: Greif is on track to ensure colleagues receive equal pay for equal work and is committed to maintaining gender pay parity.

T:P1.20.text: Evaluate the Sustainability Performance for 80% of Total Spend with Suppliers

T:P1.21.text: By aiming to increase the evaluation of the sustainability performance of its suppliers, Greif can have a greater impact across its value chain.
